TreeRecord.title: TreeRecord
TreeRecord.description: Digital Tree Passport record representing a registered urban tree and its latest health, risk priority, and Stress Debt telemetry.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns this tree record.

treeCode.description: Human-readable permanent tree passport ID (e.g., TG-VJA-0001).

zone.description: Municipal ward, street, or zone description.

structuralScore.description: Structural concerns factor S (-1 if unknown, or 0-100).

exposureScore.description: Public/property exposure factor E (-1 if unknown, or 0-100).

declineScore.description: Visible decline factor D (-1 if unknown, or 0-100).

weatherScore.description: Weather concerns factor W (-1 if unknown, or 0-100).

historyScore.description: Inspection history factor T (-1 if unknown, or 0-100).

stressDebt.description: Current accumulated Tree Stress Debt TD_t.

previousStressDebt.description: Previous accumulated Tree Stress Debt TD_(t-1).

ObservationRecord.title: ObservationRecord
ObservationRecord.description: Dated visual inspection or AI Tree Doctor screening report for a specific tree.

treeId.description: Firestore document ID of the associated tree.

imageTag.description: Image preset key or local URI reference.

imageQuality.description: Assessed photograph clarity and framing quality.

possibleSpecies.description: Possible species identified from visual cues.

visibleSymptoms.description: Observable symptoms noted in the photograph.

possibleConcerns.description: Non-diagnostic possible concerns inferred from visible signs.

recommendedAction.description: Recommended next maintenance or inspection step.

professionalInspection.description: Whether urgent certified arborist inspection is recommended.

StressRecord.title: StressRecord
StressRecord.description: Longitudinal Tree Stress Debt calculation snapshot with exponential decay.

date.description: ISO date string for the calculation period.

stressDebt.description: Accumulated Stress Debt TD_t after exponential decay.

deltaDays.description: Days elapsed since previous stress calculation.

MaintenanceAction.title: MaintenanceAction
MaintenanceAction.description: Proposed or scheduled maintenance action evaluated by the What-If Maintenance Optimizer.

action.description: Description of the proposed maintenance or arborist intervention.

expectedBenefit.description: Expected risk-reduction or health benefit score (0-100).

priorityScore.description: Tree inspection-priority score at the time of proposal.

isDemoAssumption.description: True when cost/benefit values are synthetic demo estimates.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last status update.

WeatherRecord.title: WeatherRecord
WeatherRecord.description: Regional environmental weather telemetry retrieved from Open-Meteo.

zone.description: Regional zone name (e.g., Vijayawada Urban Core).

soilMoisture.description: Volumetric soil moisture m3/m3 (-1 if unavailable).

StormComparison.title: StormComparison
StormComparison.description: Longitudinal visual comparison between an earlier and newer photograph of a tree via the Storm Memory Engine.

earlierLabel.description: Label or date of the baseline earlier photograph.

laterLabel.description: Label or date of the newer comparison photograph.

isValidComparison.description: Whether the two images depict comparable views of a tree.

anglesComparable.description: Whether camera perspectives are reasonably aligned.

possibleChanges.description: Summary of observed canopy, branch, leaf, or trunk changes.

newlyVisibleDamage.description: Newly visible broken branches, bark fissures, or leaning.

unchangedFeatures.description: Structural or foliar features that remained stable.

/trees/{treeId}.description: Registered urban trees scoped to the authenticated user.

/observations/{observationId}.description: Visual observations and AI Tree Doctor screening history.

/stress_records/{stressRecordId}.description: Historical Tree Stress Debt calculation records.

/maintenance_actions/{actionId}.description: Proposed and scheduled tree maintenance actions.

/storm_comparisons/{comparisonId}.description: Saved Storm Memory before/after photograph comparison reports.
